purpose: Identify active and likely visual glitches for Pass 9 before applying source repairs.

source_plan_basis.pass9_name: Bank Owner / Continuous Run Owner Split
source_plan_basis.core_problem: Fix the Bank / Continuous Run ownership confusion behind the current visual glitch.
source_plan_basis.locked_rule: Bank Owner owns Bank shell. Continuous Run Owner owns Continuous Run content. Level 3+ must not visually appear until Bank Owner ready, Bank tab/home/buttons ready, Continuous Run opener exists, ordered panel stack ready, and readiness gate passes.
source_plan_basis.important_correction: This ledger supersedes any overly optimistic Pass 9 acceptance/certification language. Pass 9 is not close to finished.

known_stable_fixes_before_this_run.description: Bank loads again after Bank Owner dependency bridge exposes APIs across same-origin frames.
Legacy Control diagnostics visible host was disabled at source.
Legacy owner diagnostics foundation was made receipt-only and no longer renders Control diagnostics.
Control room cleanup no longer renders visible diagnostic proof buttons.

glitches.title: Bank Owner still directly mounts Continuous Run content
evidence: topHTML() builds Run State Summary, Lossless Slots ZIP Import, Staging Transfer Store, and Bank Project Registry inside the Bank owner file.
lvlHTML() builds Level 1 / Level 2 sequence inside the Bank owner file.
ensure(s,on) inserts top sequence before data-run-bank-tools and level sequence after data-run-bank-tools.
openBank(d,'continuous_run') toggles data-run-bank-tools and calls ensure(s,true).
glitches.why_it_is_a_pass9_glitch: Pass 9 says Bank Owner owns Bank shell and may hand a Continuous Run slot to Continuous Run Owner; it may not own/mount Continuous Run panel stack content directly.
glitches.expected_fix_direction: Create or activate a Continuous Run Owner content slot. Bank Owner should create only a legal slot/handoff surface and selected bank state. Continuous Run Owner should mount/move/order Continuous Run panels inside that slot.

glitches.title: Continuous Run content has two competing painters
evidence: pmp-master-bank-tab-v1.js builds/places Continuous Run top sequence, Level 1/2, run state detail, and helper bank area.
pmp-bank-screen-owner-v1.js paints data-bank-screen-owner-v1 under data-run-bank-tools with Run State Summary, Lossless Slots ZIP Import, Staging Transfer Store, and Bank Project Registry.
Both sources contain Run State Summary / ZIP / Staging / Registry concepts.
glitches.why_it_is_a_pass9_glitch: Two owners can produce duplicate panels, order drift, flicker, or one owner undoing the other. Pass 9 requires one Continuous Run Owner for Continuous Run content.
glitches.expected_fix_direction: Choose the real Continuous Run Owner. Convert the other source to shell/handoff or compatibility-only. Preserve content but remove duplicate authority.
do_not_fix_by: mutation observer cleanup as the primary fix

glitches.title: Readiness gate is incomplete for Level 3+ early-visual rule
evidence: pmp-master-bank-tab-v1.js bankReady(d) only checks Bank buttons, non-loading text, and data-open-bank='continuous_run'.
Pass 9 readiness requires Bank Owner ready, Bank tab/home/buttons ready, Continuous Run opener exists, ordered panel stack ready, and readiness gate passes before Level 3+ visual content appears.
No current source inspected in this run proves a single full readiness gate owns that entire chain.
glitches.why_it_is_a_pass9_glitch: The current glitch is not solved until Level 3+ does not appear or flash before Bank readiness and ordered Continuous Run stack readiness.
glitches.expected_fix_direction: Build or wire a Continuous Run readiness gate that explicitly reports bank_owner_ready, bank_buttons_ready, continuous_run_opener_ready, continuous_run_slot_ready, ordered_panel_stack_ready, and level3plus_allowed.

glitches.title: Bank Owner has an active paint readiness loop
evidence: startPaintReadiness(d) runs setInterval every 250ms until Bank ready or 20 seconds.
paint(d,true) can be called repeatedly during startup.
We already saw repeated remover/repair loops cause flicker in this pass.
glitches.why_it_is_a_pass9_glitch: Even if this loop is inside Bank Owner, it can still create visual instability if Continuous Run panels are also being inserted or moved during readiness. Pass 9 needs controlled ownership, not race-driven repaint.
glitches.expected_fix_direction: After ownership split, replace broad repaint loop with state-gated one-shot or event-based readiness handoff. Do not remove until Bank startup has a safe replacement.
do_not_fix_by: turning off Bank paint loop before replacement readiness exists

glitches.title: Legacy loader still injects Pass 7 owner/helper scripts repeatedly
evidence: Loader injects pmp-owner-diagnostics-host-v1.js, pmp-owner-diagnostics-foundation-v1.js, section owner registry, helper registry, runtime probe, coverage lock, and certification gate.
Loader runs scan on load and every 900ms.
Some scripts are now receipt-only, but the loader still creates continuous script/probe pressure.
glitches.why_it_is_a_pass9_glitch: This can reintroduce old visible diagnostics or helper scans unless all loaded scripts are source-safe. It is not the main Bank / Continuous Run glitch, but it is a stability risk during Pass 9.
glitches.expected_fix_direction: Keep current receipt-only patches. Later, once Pass 9 owners are stable, narrow the loader to only required runtime proof scripts or reduce scan cadence. Do not touch before the core Bank/Continuous Run split unless it causes a visible glitch.

glitches.title: Bank Owner dependency bridge is a temporary boundary patch, not final architecture
evidence: pmp-master-bank-tab-v1.js R/RB/ST/LZ/SZ/PR lookup APIs on window only.
pmp-bank-owner-dependency-bridge-v1.js copies APIs across same-origin frames so Bank owner can see them.
glitches.why_it_is_a_pass9_glitch: The bridge is currently safe and working, but Pass 9 final architecture should not depend on helpers compensating for owner dependency lookup if the owner can be made frame-aware directly.
glitches.expected_fix_direction: After the main ownership split is stable, either keep the bridge as an official dependency boundary or make Bank Owner lookups explicitly frame-aware. Do not change now unless it regresses.

glitches.title: Bad helper patterns have been identified but remain important guardrails
evidence: Native repair loop caused Bank flicker and was disabled.
Probe bridge addressed the wrong problem and was disabled.
Visible diagnostic button interceptor interfered and was disabled.
Control migration/quarantine hid or moved too broadly and were disabled.
glitches.why_it_is_a_pass9_glitch: Any future fix that resembles these patterns can recreate flicker or ownership fights.
glitches.expected_fix_direction: All future fixes must be source-owner repairs or receipt-only diagnostics, not repeated DOM repair loops.

glitches.title: No complete runtime visual proof has been captured for current stable Bank -> Continuous Run path
evidence: Diagnostics includes Bank / Continuous Run Visual State, but the current stable runtime still needs a fresh run with Continuous Run Bank open.
Prior reports did not fully exercise Continuous Run detail content in the now-stable state.
glitches.why_it_is_a_pass9_glitch: Glitch ledger needs real observed runtime proof for what appears early, wrong, duplicate, missing, or stable.
glitches.expected_fix_direction: Run the visual diagnostic only after a source-level Continuous Run Owner split plan is clear, or run it now as observation-only before changes.

immediate_fix_order_recommendation.move: Define the real Continuous Run Owner boundary and stop Bank Owner from directly mounting Continuous Run content beyond a legal slot.
Add/readiness-gate proof before allowing Level 3+ visual appearance.
Replace race-like Bank paint loop only after safe readiness handoff exists.
Run Bank / Continuous Run Visual State on the repaired owner split to verify no early Level 3+, no duplicates, no flicker.

do_not_do: Do not call Pass 9 close or certified.
Do not add another repeating DOM remover.
Do not clear IndexedDB or storage.
Do not hide all Level 3+ globally without an owner readiness gate.
Do not make Control or Diagnostics cleanup the focus of Pass 9 now; current real target is Bank / Continuous Run owner split.

run_001_decision.primary_open_glitch: Bank Owner is still directly mounting Continuous Run content and competing with the Continuous Run/Bank Screen owner path.
run_001_decision.next_best_move: Design and implement Pass 9 Fix 001: Continuous Run Owner Slot Contract. Bank Owner creates only slot + selected bank state; Continuous Run Owner owns content stack inside slot.
